test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘FRIEND’ is written as ‘GQJDOC’, and ‘READER’ is written as ‘SDBCFQ’. How will ‘NUMBER’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

‘FRIEND’ is written as ‘GQJDOC’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b67742c3c8999470d5451c93c13b3a4d1a20a87ef8b5d1e86b4002c16af8f56a.png] 

‘READER’ is written as ‘SDBCFQ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2abe818ba3046d6b94b7a6bdab6128dedb750ee07aea58c1df026bae605e9ca1.png] 

Similarly, ‘NUMBER’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92ae92bc42e89411a512406c29de5a84004b1112e04c80f56ff17a5eb2d282ba.png] 

Hence, **'option 2'** is the correct answer.
